source_text: 47 FIDELES CAVETE MALUM. Fallantur uolucres et siluarum bestei escis: Incauta natura quibus est tradita mentis, Decipiunturque strofia aut esca sequentes, Et uitare malum nesciunt nec lege tenentur. Lex homini data est et doctrina uitae legenda, Ex qua recordatur, ut possit uiuere caute, Sui quoque locum, mortis et deroget ea quae sunt. Condemnat se ipsum grauiter qui regi delinquet: Aut ferro ligatur aut decus gradu deiectus Uel uita priuatus perdet, quod frui deberet. Exemplo moniti grauiter peccare nolite, Translati lauacro magis caritatem habete, Et escam muscipuli, ubi mors est, longe uitate. Multa sunt martyria, quae sunt sine sanguine fuso. Alienum non cupire, uelle martyrii habere, Linguam refrenare, humilem te reddere debes, Uim ultro non facere nec factam reddere contra Mens patiens fueris: intellege martyrem esse.
pass_a_gloss: Beasts snared without law; human has lex et doctrina vitae. Who sins against king condemns self. Washed (lauacro) → caritas; avoid death’s bait. Many martyria without blood; humility/patience = martyr.
pass_b_english: Let birds and beasts of the woods be deceived by foods: an incautious nature of mind has been handed to them; they are caught by tricks or following bait, and they do not know how to avoid evil nor are they held by law. Law has been given to the human and a teaching of life to be read, from which he remembers so he can live carefully, and also may refuse his place and the things that are of death. He condemns himself heavily who offends the king: either he is bound with iron or cast down from the dignity of rank, or deprived of life he will lose what he ought to enjoy. Warned by the example do not sin heavily; transferred by the washing rather have charity, and avoid far the bait of the trap where death is. There are many martyrdoms that are without blood poured. Not to desire another’s, to want to have martyrdom, to rein the tongue, to make yourself humble — you ought; not to do violence of yourself nor to return it when done — be a patient mind: understand that you are a martyr.

choices.choose: live by the law of life

choices.why: martyria… sine sanguine; Mens patiens… martyrem esse.

notes: Faithful: law, baptismal charity, bloodless martyrdom.
